question: Is there a waiting period?
answer: Many final expense policies — especially graded or modified benefit plans — include a 2-year waiting period for death from natural causes. During that period, beneficiaries typically receive premiums paid plus interest instead of the full face amount. Immediate-benefit (level) plans can offer no waiting period for applicants who qualify in good health. Accidental death typically pays full benefit from day one.
